# Contracts Checklist: ISK-0010 — System-Operator Bootstrap & Security Baseline

**Purpose**: Check that the new `operator-security` contract and the four revisions are complete, versioned, owned, and consistent with the spec and with each other, and that compatibility commitments are measurable
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Versioning and ownership

- [x] CHK001 - Does the `operator-security` contract state its version, owning spec, change procedure, and the review owner of each section? [Completeness, Spec §TR-19, Contract header, §Changing this contract]
- [x] CHK002 - Does each revision (container 3, hosting 4, persistence 4, local environment 3) record its change, approval, and owner in its change table? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039, Contract change tables]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the conditional module dependency rules revision resolved, with the reason it is not published? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039, Plan §Constitution Check, Research R1]
- [x] CHK004 - Does each revision state which rules are unchanged, so earlier specs' tests remain valid? [Completeness, Container, Hosting, Persistence, Local environment change tables]
- [x] CHK005 - Is each maintainer decision from `plan` recorded where its rule lives, with the decider and date? [Traceability, Spec §Maintainer decisions taken in `plan`, Contract §Ownership 3, §Composition 3, §Transport 3]

## Consistency across contracts

- [x] CHK006 - Do the container contract's Listeners and the operator-security contract name the same admin routes and prefix? [Consistency, Container §Listeners 5, Contract §Admin routes 1]
- [x] CHK007 - Do the hosting contract's Registration mistakes and the operator-security contract give the same codes and events for composition and declaration failures? [Consistency, Hosting §Registration mistakes, Contract §Admin routes 2]
- [x] CHK008 - Do the persistence revision's migration order and the spec's rollback rule agree on exactly two reverse steps? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032, Persistence §Migrations 12]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the worker's composition stated identically in the spec, the container contract, and the hosting contract? [Consistency, Spec §TR-11, Container §Entry points 2, Hosting §Embedding the control plane 5]
- [x] CHK010 - Do the anonymous inventory table and its rule source have one stated owner and a rule that they match? [Consistency, Contract §Anonymous endpoint inventory 1]

## Error codes, exit codes, and compatibility

- [x] CHK011 - Does the code list cover every refusal TR-17 names, each with a category and where it surfaces? [Completeness, Spec §TR-17, Contract §Error codes]
- [x] CHK012 - Are new exit codes added without reusing or changing an existing one, and is each mapped to one code? [Consistency, Spec §TR-11, Container §Command line and exit codes 2]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the `core-contracts` bump stated as additions only, with no change to `hosting`, and can the harness check it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-040, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK014 - Is it stated where the new codes and resource type are recorded outside `ErrorCodes`, and whether that is a revision? [Clarity, Research R17]

## Breaking-change rules and boundaries

- [x] CHK015 - Does the `operator-security` contract name what is breaking (routes, actions, roles, reason classes, audit actions, codes, events, metrics, fields)? [Completeness, Contract §Changing this contract]
- [x] CHK016 - Are the items left to later specs named with their spec? [Completeness, Contract §Left to later specs, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK017 - Are ISK-0006's and ISK-0007's AV-5 recorded as settled in the contracts that own them? [Traceability, Spec §FR-022b, Contract §Composition 1, §Transport 5, Container §Listeners 7]

## Documentation

- [x] CHK018 - Are the `docs/03`, `docs/04`, and `docs/05` changes required by name, with the links to repoint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039, §FR-041]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the owning-spec XML comment requirement stated for every added port and adapter type? [Completeness, Spec §FR-042, Contract §Ownership 4]
